Package AppBuilder

Class Interactor

java.lang.Object
AppBuilder.Interactor
public class Interactor extends Object
The Interactor class provides methods to add and remove actions for inputs while the window is active

  • Method Details

    • addButtonAction

      public static void addButtonAction(AbstractButton button, Runnable action)
      Adds an action to a button that will be performed when the button is clicked. In order to replace the action that is performed (like changing a button binding), just call this method and put in the new action
      Parameters:
      button - The button that the action is attached to.
      action - The runnable that will be called when the button is clicked. You can use a lambda expression or method reference to pass this in.

    • removeButtonAction

      public static void removeButtonAction(AbstractButton button)
      Removes all actions from a button.
      Parameters:
      button - The button from which to remove all actions.

    • addKeyAction

      public static void addKeyAction(JComponent component, int keyCode, Runnable onPress)
      Adds an action to be performed when a certain key is pressed. In order to replace the action that is performed (like changing a button binding), just call this method and put in the new action
      Parameters:
      component - The component that the action is attached to. This makes it so that whenever the window that this component is in is active, the action will be performed when the key is pressed.
      keyCode - The key code representing the key that will trigger the action. See https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/awt/event/KeyEvent.html to find the keycode for any key
      onPress - The runnable that will be called when the key is pressed. You can use a lambda expression or method reference to pass this in.

    • removeKeyAction

      public static void removeKeyAction(JComponent component, int keyCode)
      Removes the action associated with a specific key code from a component.
      Parameters:
      component - The component from which the key action will be removed.
      keyCode - The key code representing the key whose action is to be removed. See https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/awt/event/KeyEvent.html to find the keycode for any key

    • addKeyReleaseAction

      public static void addKeyReleaseAction(JComponent component, int keyCode, Runnable onRelease)
      Adds an action to be performed when a certain key is released. In order to replace the action that is performed (like changing a button binding), just call this method and put in the new action
      Parameters:
      component - The component that the action is attached to. This makes it so that whenever the window that this component is in is active, the action will be performed when the key is released.
      keyCode - The key code representing the key that will trigger the action. See https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/awt/event/KeyEvent.html to find the keycode for any key
      onRelease - The runnable that will be called when the key is released. You can use a lambda expression or method reference to pass this in.

    • removeKeyReleaseAction

      public static void removeKeyReleaseAction(JComponent component, int keyCode)
      Removes the action associated with a specific key code when it is released from a component.
      Parameters:
      component - The component from which the key release action will be removed.
      keyCode - The key code representing the key whose release action is to be removed. See https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/awt/event/KeyEvent.html to find the keycode for any key

    • addKeyHoldAction

      public static void addKeyHoldAction(JComponent component, int keyCode, Runnable onHold, Runnable onRelease)
      Adds an action to be performed continuously while a certain key is held down, and stops the action when the key is released.
      Parameters:
      component - The component that the action is attached to.
      keyCode - The key code representing the key that will trigger the action. See https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/awt/event/KeyEvent.html to find the keycode for any key
      onHold - The runnable that will be called repeatedly while the key is held down. You can use a lambda expression or method reference to pass this in.
      onRelease - The runnable that will be called when the key is released. You can use a lambda expression or method reference to pass this in.
